meta.title: Rate-limit requests per client
meta.body: Adds a per-client rate limiter: a client past `REQUESTS_PER_MINUTE` (default 120) requests in the window gets a 429, and `GET /api/limits` reports the limit. `MAX_CONNECTIONS` now sets the connection cap.

baseBrief.summary: Adds a per-client rate limiter to the API: a client past the configured requests per minute gets a 429, and GET /api/limits reports the limit.

changeGroups.title: Configure the request limit
changeGroups.summary: ServerConfig gains requestsPerMinute, read from REQUESTS_PER_MINUTE with a default of 120.

changeGroups.title: Add a sliding-window rate limiter
changeGroups.summary: createRateLimiter counts each key's requests in the last 60 s and refuses one past the limit.

changeGroups.title: Report the limit at /api/limits
changeGroups.summary: routes() takes the limits and serves them as JSON at GET /api/limits.

changeGroups.title: Refuse clients past the limit
changeGroups.summary: startServer builds a limiter from the config and answers 429 before routing when a client is over it.
